nodes.label: United States
nodes.description: Major belligerent in the US-Israel war with Iran; President Trump has called for an Iranian uprising.

nodes.label: Israel
nodes.description: US ally engaged in war with Iran; also facing criticism over West Bank settler violence.

nodes.label: Iran
nodes.description: Target of US-Israeli bombing campaign; civilians sheltering at home amid war.

nodes.label: Donald Trump
nodes.description: US President who has called for an uprising in Iran during the ongoing war.

nodes.label: Vladimir Putin
nodes.description: Russian president positioning himself as a potential mediator in the Iran war.

nodes.label: Russia
nodes.description: Seeks diplomatic and economic gains from the Iran war; also engaged in conflict with Ukraine.

nodes.label: Ukraine
nodes.description: Struck a Russian missile component plant; continues war with Russia.

nodes.label: United Kingdom
nodes.description: Russia accuses UK of helping Ukraine's strike; UK also demands Israel stop settler violence.

nodes.label: European Union
nodes.description: Demands Israel stop surge in settler violence in the West Bank since Iran war began.

nodes.label: G7
nodes.description: Group of nations agreeing to record release of emergency oil reserves amid price surge.

nodes.label: US-Israel War with Iran
nodes.description: Ongoing military conflict involving US and Israeli bombing campaign against Iran.

nodes.label: Oil Price Surge
nodes.description: Surge in global oil prices caused by the US-Israel war with Iran.

nodes.label: Emergency Oil Reserve Release
nodes.description: Record release of emergency oil reserves agreed by G7 nations in response to price surge.

nodes.label: West Bank Settler Violence
nodes.description: Surge in Israeli settler attacks in the West Bank since the Iran war; six Palestinians killed.

nodes.label: Iran Uprising Call
nodes.description: Trump's call for an uprising inside Iran, drawing parallels to Iraq 1991.

nodes.label: Ukraine Strike on Russian Plant
nodes.description: Ukraine hit a Russian missile component plant; Russia blames UK assistance.

nodes.label: US Embassy Explosion in Oslo
nodes.description: Explosion at the US embassy in Oslo; three brothers arrested, possible foreign state actor involvement.

nodes.label: Norway
nodes.description: Location of the US embassy explosion in Oslo; investigating possible foreign state involvement.

nodes.label: DR Congo Drone Strikes in Goma
nodes.description: Drone strikes hit a residential building in rebel-held Goma, killing three including a French aid worker.

nodes.label: France
nodes.description: A French aid worker was killed in drone strikes in Goma, DR Congo.

nodes.label: Mark Carney
nodes.description: Canadian Prime Minister inching closer to a majority as MPs defect to the Liberals.

nodes.label: Canada
nodes.description: Canadian PM Mark Carney's Liberal party gaining MPs through defections.

nodes.label: Liberal Party of Canada
nodes.description: Governing party gaining MPs including Lori Idlout, moving closer to a majority.

nodes.label: Lori Idlout
nodes.description: Former NDP MP who defected to the Liberal Party of Canada.

nodes.label: Australia
nodes.description: Granted asylum to Iranian football delegation member; also involved in trademark case and Meghan visit.

nodes.label: Iranian Football Delegation
nodes.description: Seven women from Iranian football delegation received Australian asylum visas; activists helped them escape minders.

nodes.label: United Nations
nodes.description: Reported six Palestinians killed in West Bank settler attacks since the Iran war started.

nodes.label: Jeffrey Epstein
nodes.description: Deceased financier whose estate is still controlled by two key aides amid allegations of complicity.

nodes.label: Georgia Congressional Runoff
nodes.description: Runoff election to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene between Republican Clay Fuller and Democrat Shawn Harris.

nodes.label: Marjorie Taylor Greene
nodes.description: Former US congresswoman whose Georgia seat is being contested in a runoff election.
